TEXT:
[FI] We went to a park by the sea to watch the sunset, 
but...
[FI] This is bad, I'm gonna die of embarrassment.

[FI] I didn't think it would be so embarrassing, just 
walking together while holding hands...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] W-What's wrong? Why are you suddenly squatting 
like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's nothing, I'm just... a little dizzy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-I see. How about we rest on that bench for now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you really okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes... I'm fine. I'm okay now.

[FI] I looked up after letting out a breath of relief, the 
sun was in the midst of setting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's beautiful, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's times like these that I feel most blissful...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah.

[FI] If it's the two of us, we don't need to go to a stylish 
café or places normal couples go to. I bet she 
would say something like that.

[FI] As we're passing the time in silence, I realized 
something... Huh, don't we have a really good mood 
going right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] K-Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

[FI] Without answering, I started brushing her hair 
gently.

[FI] Kuroneko stiffened for a moment but she didn't 
resist. C-Could I... go for it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hey. Can I... kiss you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] N-No!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, I-I thought so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] W-Wait... No... T-That's not it... I was just surprised by 
you asking so suddenly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] W-With you, sometimes I cannot make light of 
whether you are being incompetent or forceful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] O-On the cheek...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Like I said, you can... um... on the cheek.
[FI] This is probably the best she can do right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I had a lot of fun today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] R-Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You planned many different things for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] You accompanied me to the many places I wanted 
to go to...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But, how was it for you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Did your heart experience as much joy as I did?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Did the soul of the black beast dwelling in your 
chest quiver?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Was I able to satisfy you, even with my cowardice?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You're not regretting receiving my curse, are you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why would you say that?

[FI] It was fun and exciting. My girlfriend was cute 
today as well. That's why I can only reply to those 
questions with a question of my own.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] B-But you're with someone who still hasn't given 
you another curse (kiss) since we started dating, I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're worried about that, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That? I am seriously asking you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I have fun just being with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I had a lot of fun today. So, we should go on 
another date someday.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes, I agree.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, but I do have one thing I am unsatisfied with.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Wh-What would that be? Let's see, depending on 
what it is, I'm not reluctant to try and improve on it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No, it's nothing serious. I was thinking you could call 
me by my name, instead of "senpai" from now on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] B-By... your name?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You know, we're dating, yet calling me senpai still is 
a bit disappointing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Y-You say that, but you call me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You sure? Okay then, I'll call you Ruri from now on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Ah---uh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Let's come here again sometime, R-Ruri...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...N-No, it's Kuroneko, please call me Kuroneko. My 
heart's not ready yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-I understand... Well, shall we leave soon?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Let's stay a bit longer... Just for a while, I want to be 
with you, Senpa-... K-Kyousuke.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah, got it.

[FI] We took in the time together as the afterglow of 
the setting sun shone upon us.
